title: Big and Small
short: Find the biggest and the smallest.

blocks.html: Things come in different sizes. An elephant is big. A mouse is small. Which ball is the biggest? Which is the smallest?

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Which ball is the biggest? Which is the smallest?

blocks.html: Big, bigger, biggest. Small, smaller, smallest.

For the grown-up: Line up three things of the same kind but different sizes: spoons, shoes or bowls. Ask which is biggest and smallest. Size words are math words. Short and happy beats long. Five minutes is a good lesson.

items: Try it at home: Line up family shoes from small to big.
Find a big leaf and a small leaf.
